onb1.title: Onboarding 1: Your roadmap
paras: This community gives you training, strategies, skills, tools, and coaching to help you build and grow an online business using AI, SaaS, and GoHighLevel.
The best place to begin is with your current goal.
If you're new, start with the foundational training. Get comfortable with the tools and think through who you want to help.
If you have an idea, use the building and SaaS training to start putting it together.
If you already have an offer, focus on client acquisition, follow-up, and improving how you deliver.
Choose one outcome you want to accomplish this week, then find the lesson or resource that helps you get there.

As you go, use the downloadable skills and prompts with the details of your own business. Bring your questions into the community, and use coaching to work through anything that needs a deeper conversation.
Check the pinned posts and announcements for exclusive drops, new training, and coaching updates.
Start by introducing yourself. Tell us where you're at, what you want to build, and your goal for this week.
Then head into the Classroom and begin.

onb2.title: Onboarding 2: Build in public
paras: You'll get the most out of this community when people can see what you're working on.
There's training here on AI, SaaS, GoHighLevel, and growing an online business. You also have skills, prompts, tools, exclusive drops, and coaching to help you apply it.
As you start using those resources, share your progress.
Post the offer you're developing. Show the product you're building. Ask about the part of your workflow that's giving you trouble.
When you ask a question, explain what you want to accomplish, what you've tried, and where you're stuck. That gives people enough context to help.
Bring those questions into coaching too. You'll get more from a session when you arrive with something specific to work through.
And spend a little time looking at what other members are building. You may find an idea you can apply, someone working through the same challenge, or a question you already know how to answer.
Your first post can be simple. Share what you do, what brought you here, and what you're working toward.
Then pick a training and start sharing your progress as you go.

onb3.title: Onboarding 3: Your first 7 days
paras: Before you open the first training, choose something you want to finish.
It could be getting your GoHighLevel account set up, creating your first offer, building a working demo, or putting together a follow-up sequence.
Give yourself a clear target.
You have training, skills, prompts, tools, and coaching here to help you move toward it. Start with the resource that addresses the next thing you need to figure out.
Watch the lesson with your project open. Pause, apply the step, and see what happens.
When you get stuck, post your question or bring it into coaching. Include what you're building and the decision you need help making.
You'll see new training and exclusive drops as the AI landscape changes. Use those when they help you move your current project forward.
For now, your first assignment is to post one thing you want to accomplish in the next seven days.
At the end of the week, come back and share what you finished, what you learned, and what you're doing next.
Let's get your first piece in place.
